about: The AP Microeconomics app pages. scripts/build-apmicro.mjs writes each page's shell (head, header, footer, a <div id="app"> mount) from this file; the page's behavior is its script in microeconomics/assets/<script>, which mounts into #app. "static": true marks a generated page that is not an app (teachers.html). premium names the Premium feature (ApMicroCore gates it); card is the line on the course home. No path may contain the token "ap" (docs/apmicro-spec.md decision 2). tools[] are the eight trainers of docs/apmicro-spec.md section 6, pre-registered in Phase 0: page microeconomics/tools/<slug>.html, script microeconomics/assets/tools/<slug>.js, model microeconomics/assets/tools/math/<slug>.js (ApMicroMath.<camelSlug>), content microeconomics/data/tools/<slug>.json, validator scripts/lib/apmicro-tool-checks/<slug>.mjs, test scripts/test/apmicro-tool-<slug>.test.mjs (docs/apmicro-architecture.md, "Tools"). topic is the tool's context topic: the tool is built only when its data file exists and that topic is published. FREE OR PREMIUM is set here and only here: a tool with "premium": "tools" is Premium; graph-studio, elasticity-lab and game-lab carry none and are free (docs/apmicro-spec.md section 6).

apps.title: Practice questions
apps.desc: Microeconomics practice by unit, topic or skill: graphs to shift, label and shade, payoff matrices, calculations, and data and scenario sets.
apps.card: Drill a unit, a topic or a skill, with graphs to shift and shade, matrices and calculations.

apps.title: Spaced review
apps.desc: Your microeconomics spaced review queue: every question you missed comes back just before you would forget it.
apps.card: Missed questions come back when you are about to forget them.

apps.title: Exams
apps.desc: Timed microeconomics unit tests and full practice exams in the May 2027 format: 60 multiple-choice questions, then three free-response questions.
apps.card: Unit tests and full timed practice exams in the May 2027 format.

apps.title: Free-response practice
apps.desc: Microeconomics free-response practice: long and short questions with graphs and payoff matrices on the page, a rubric point by point and a full-credit sample.
apps.card: One long and two short questions, with rubrics, graphs and matrices on the page and sample answers.

apps.title: Make it specific
apps.desc: Microeconomics written answers made specific enough to score: MR = MC with the numbers, price from demand, both comparisons and every link of the long run.
apps.lede: Write the answer, then check it against the rubric and two model answers: one that earns the point and one that loses it.
apps.card: The marginal rule, the right area, both comparisons and every link, checked against a rubric.

apps.title: Cram kit
apps.desc: Microeconomics cram plans counted back from your exam date: three or two weeks, day by day, weighted by unit, with timed sets and practice exams.
apps.lede: A 3-week or 2-week plan counted back from your exam date, day by day: unit sheets and notes, a timed mixed set and one free-response question each study day, two full practice exams and rest days. Print it and tick the days off.
apps.card: 3-week and 2-week plans to exam day, and timed mixed sets.

apps.title: Flashcards
apps.desc: Spaced-repetition microeconomics flashcards built from the glossary and the formulas you must know, by unit and topic.
apps.card: Spaced-repetition cards from the glossary and the formulas.

apps.title: Tools
apps.desc: Microeconomics trainers: the graph studio, elasticity, surplus and areas, cost curves, firm and market, game theory, factor markets and externalities.
apps.card: Trainers and simulators, then the questions about what you saw.

apps.title: Progress
apps.desc: Your microeconomics mastery by unit, topic and skill, with every miss linked to the lesson that teaches it.
apps.card: Mastery by unit, topic and skill.

apps.title: Search the course
apps.desc: Search every microeconomics lesson, notes page, glossary term and tool in the course.

apps.title: For teachers
apps.desc: For microeconomics teachers: stable share links, printable notes and unit sheets, and Google Classroom sharing, with no new student data collected.
apps.lede: Share any notes page, lesson or unit sheet with a stable link. Students need no account, and nothing they do leaves their device unless they choose to sign in.

tools.name: Graph studio
tools.title: Graph Studio
tools.desc: Every graph the exam asks for, drawn, labeled, shifted and shaded by hand, graded point by point the way readers score them, with the slip named.
tools.blurb: Draw, label, shift and shade every graph, graded per rubric point.
tools.lede: Shift the curve, shade the area, see what the reader sees.

tools.name: Elasticity lab
tools.title: Elasticity Lab
tools.desc: Price, income and cross-price elasticity from tables and graphs, the total revenue test, and the elastic and inelastic ranges of a demand curve.
tools.blurb: Price, income and cross elasticity and the total revenue test.
tools.lede: Percent change over percent change, and what it says about revenue.

tools.name: Surplus lab
tools.title: Surplus and Policy Lab
tools.desc: Price controls, taxes, subsidies and tariffs: shade consumer and producer surplus, tax revenue, subsidy cost and deadweight loss, then compute each area.
tools.blurb: Shade and compute surplus, revenue, subsidy cost and deadweight loss.
tools.lede: Shade the right area, then find its size.

tools.name: Cost lab
tools.title: Cost Curve Lab
tools.desc: Fill a cost table (MP, MC, AFC, AVC, ATC), watch the curves draw, and see MC pass through the minimum of AVC and ATC.
tools.blurb: Cost tables to cost curves, with MC through the minimums.
tools.lede: Divide by the change in output, then watch the curves draw.

tools.name: Firm and market
tools.title: Firm and Market Lab
tools.desc: Perfect competition from the short run to the long run, monopoly and monopolistic competition: quantity where MR = MC, price from demand, the profit or loss box.
tools.blurb: MR = MC, price from demand, and the profit box.
tools.lede: Find the quantity, read the price, box the profit.

tools.name: Game theory lab
tools.title: Game Theory Lab
tools.desc: Payoff matrices: best responses, dominant strategies, every Nash equilibrium, and the two-comparison argument the exam wants.
tools.blurb: Dominant strategies, Nash equilibria and both comparisons.

tools.name: Factor lab
tools.title: Factor Market Lab
tools.desc: Hiring where MRP = MRC from a table, derived demand from the product market, the least-cost rule and monopsony wages read from labor supply.
tools.blurb: MRP = MRC hiring, derived demand and monopsony.
tools.lede: Hire while the next worker adds more than she costs.

tools.name: Externality lab
tools.title: Externality Lab
tools.desc: Marginal social benefit and cost, the market quantity against the efficient one, deadweight loss, the corrective tax or subsidy, and public goods.
tools.blurb: Market vs efficient quantity, deadweight loss and the fix.
tools.lede: Find the gap between private and social, then close it.
